responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s text-art visualization for memory-access diagnostics such as out-of-bounds reads and writes. This file computes valid-versus-actual accessed bit/byte ranges from region-model data, maps those ranges onto aligned table columns and ruler labels, formats spatial items such as the accessed value and base region, and paints direction arrows and capacity/overflow annotations into text_art widgets so bounds-checking diagnostics can emit a compact diagram explaining where an access lands relative to the valid object layout.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line implementation of the access-diagram facility declared in access-diagram.h, including the rendering logic, layout/paining helpers, and selftests for turning access_operation data into text-art diagnostics.
